Woman Officer Takes Command of Elite Jungle Warfare Unit

Sanjukta Parashar has become the first woman officer to lead the CoBRA (Commando Battalion for Resolute Action) unit, a jungle warfare commando force under the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF). Parashar, an Indian Police Service (IPS) officer, is known as the 'Iron Lady of Assam'. Her appointment marks a significant milestone for women in leadership roles within specialized combat units.
